metadata.title: fix: remove setup-node from GitHub workflows
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #

---

## 📝 Summary
This PR removes `actions/setup-node` from the affected GitHub Actions workflows because IBM repository policy blocks that action. The workflows now use the default Node.js and npm installation already available on `ubuntu-latest`, with an explicit version check so failures are obvious if the runner image changes.

---

| GitHub Actions lint       | `actionlint`                                           | Passed |
| Repo commit hooks         | `git commit -s -m "fix: remove setup-node from GitHub workflows"` | Passed |

---

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
- [ ] Tests added/updated for changes

---

## 📓 Notes (optional)

- I did not mark the formatting, tests, or docs boxes because they do not apply directly to this workflow-only update.
